product.name: Charming
product.shortDescription: Build and iterate hosted web apps
product.packageDescription: Create, update, and inspect Charming-hosted interactive web apps.
product.longDescription: Charming is an MCP server that generates, hosts, and updates small interactive web apps. Each app gets a real URL, persistent storage, and inline rendering in MCP Apps-capable clients, and it keeps working after the chat closes.

defaultPrompts: Build me a personal web app with Charming.
Update my Charming app from feedback.
Connect Charming MCP in this session.

clients.label: Claude, Grok, Gemini, Perplexity, and most MCP clients
ChatGPT
clients.note: or the Charming listing in the ChatGPT Apps directory

tools.name: create_app
tools.summary: Store an agent-authored ES module plus optional UI and CSS, and render it inline. Returns the public app URL.

tools.name: update_app
tools.summary: Edit an existing app by replacing its module/UI/styles or applying exact-string edits with optimistic-concurrency versioning.

tools.name: get_app
tools.summary: Render an existing app inline (where the client supports it) and return its callable API operations and metadata.

tools.name: get_app_source
tools.summary: Return the persisted module, UI, and styles for an existing app plus its current version.

tools.name: list_apps
tools.summary: List the calling user's apps, newest first, with descriptions and capabilities.

tools.name: delete_app
tools.summary: Delete an app's module entry. Pass `purge_storage: true` to also wipe stored state.

tools.name: upload_asset
tools.summary: Store a static asset (image, PDF, dataset) so app code stays small; readable back same-origin.

tools.name: rename_app
tools.summary: Change an app's URL slug. The old URL keeps working by redirecting.

tools.name: set_remixable
tools.summary: Mark an app remixable so visitors get their own editable copy.

tools.name: unset_remixable
tools.summary: Stop allowing remixes; existing remixes survive untouched.

tools.name: set_starter_prompt
tools.summary: Set or clear the prompt prefilled in the chat host when a visitor opens a shared app.

tools.name: query_app
tools.summary: Run a read-only backend operation inside an app module.

tools.name: mutate_app
tools.summary: Run a mutating backend operation inside an app module without editing code.

tools.name: submit_feedback
tools.summary: Record agent-authored feedback (bugs, enhancements, crash reports) about an app.

tools.name: list_feedback
tools.summary: List feedback rows for the caller's apps, newest first.

tools.name: set_handle
tools.summary: Change the signed-in user's handle (the first segment of their app URLs).

tools.name: share_app
tools.summary: Invite another user to collaborate on an app; they accept the invite to get access.

tools.name: unshare_app
tools.summary: Revoke a collaborator's access to an app.

tools.name: list_app_shares
tools.summary: List active and pending share invites for one of your apps.

tools.name: set_public
tools.summary: Make an app public: anyone with the URL can open it with no login.

tools.name: unset_public
tools.summary: Make a public app private again; anonymous visitors can no longer open it.
